'''Stewjon''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Stewjon system/Legends|Stewjon system]]. It had an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that allowed [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to breathe [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] comfortably. Stewjon was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Kenobi family/Legends|family]], though he was taken from the planet at a [[Youngling/Legends|young age]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Description==
Located in the [[Stewjon system/Legends|Stewjon system]],<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> Stewjon was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that consisted of a breathable [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] mix that could support [[Human/Legends|Human]] life. The world had a climate that supported the growth of [[Grass/Legends|grass]].<ref name="JATHP" />

==History==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]],<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref> the Human [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was born on Stewjon to his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's mother/Legends|mother]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's father/Legends|father]]. Soon afterward, he was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and was taken from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he began his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

By the time he was around 13-years-old<ref name="kenobi age">According to {{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}, Obi-Wan Kenobi was born in [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]]. According to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]'' took place in 44 ABY. Therefore, Kenobi was approximately 13-years-old during those events.</ref> and a [[Padawan]], Kenobi did not remember much of living with his [[Kenobi family/Legends|family]] on Stewjon. He could recall some memories such as eating fruit with his brother, [[Owen (Kenobi)|Owen]]. They did so in a grassy area on the world. Nonetheless, the Jedi Order allowed Kenobi to occasionally visit his family on Stewjon after his initial training.<ref name="JATHP" /><ref name="Twitter Q&A">{{Twitter|starwars|status/21159260939|[[StarWars.com]]|quote=Q: Where's Obi-Wan's home planet? Lucas. 'He comes from the planet Stewjon.'|archivedate=20190801103354}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is one of the first things I wrote in the very first script. He comes from the planet Stewjon.|George Lucas, joking about Obi-Wan's planet of origin|<ref name="sw.com">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/jon_stewart_george_lucas_main_event/index.html|text=''Star Wars'' Celebration Main Event: Play by Play}}</ref>}}
[[File:Obi-Wan_Kenobi_Clone_Card.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stewjon's reference on Obi-Wan Kenobi's "Clone Card"]]
Speculation about Obi-Wan Kenobi's homeworld first appeared in chapter 26 of the [[1998]] novel ''[[I, Jedi]]'', when [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] asks [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], "Wasn't [<nowiki />[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]] Obi-Wan Kenobi's homeworld?" Luke doesn't address the question.

The world was first seen, albeit unnamed, in a flashback in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]'', the third book of the young-readers series ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'', published on [[August 1]], [[1999]] and written by [[Jude Watson]].

[[June 21]], [[2010]]<ref name="TCWCE Date">{{DK|url=us/9780756663087-star-wars-the-clone-wars-character-encyclopedia|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|nolive=1}}</ref> saw the publication of the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', which listed Coruscant as Kenobi's homeworld. Other Jedi were listed with the planet of their birth, such as [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], so at that point it was established that Kenobi was born there<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> even though residential areas on Coruscant were high above the surface with unnatural metallic floors that lacked grass for Kenobi to come into contact with.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

This situation changed at the [[Celebration V]] convention during "The Main Event," a scripted interview between ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] and talk-show host [[Jon Stewart]] that took place on [[August 14]], 2010.<ref name="celebration">{{Celebration|url=en/Events/Questions-For-George|text=The Main Event|celebration=[[Celebration V]]|nolive=1}}</ref> During the panel, Stewart asked Lucas for the name of Kenobi's homeworld, to which Lucas replied, "Stewjon," a [[tuckerization]] of Stewart's name.<ref name="sw.com" />

Official ''Star Wars'' [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] feeds reported this shortly thereafter,<ref name="Twitter Q&A" /> which led to some ''Star Wars'' staff, including author [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Holocron continuity database]] keeper [[Leland Chee]], confirming on their respective Twitter feeds that the planet Stewjon would appear in future editions of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the Holocron.<ref name="Twitter Leland">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/21161475288|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=Yes, Stewjon will be in the Holocron.|archivedate=20190722081920}}</ref><ref name="Twitter Wallace">{{Twitter|danwall88|status/21160396523|[[Daniel Wallace]]|archivedate=20191010063227}}</ref> According to Wallace, Chee, [[Jason Fry]], and he were discussing the correct spelling and galactic map placement of the planet less than an hour after Lucas made the joke.<ref name="facebook">{{Facebook|username=danwall88|url=danwall88/posts/271350192923194|name=Dan Wallace|text=Dan Wallace|date=2011-12-22|archivedate=20191010063231}}</ref> The planet's name fell under the category of [[Star Wars Legends#Official levels of canon|G-canon]], which was anything Lucas directly provided to [[Lucasfilm]]&mdash;the highest form of continuity in the ''Star Wars'' universe at the time. Thus, Kenobi's recently established birth on Coruscant, made official by a lesser source, was overridden. This incident is similar to Lucas naming [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] after comedian [[Conan O'Brien]], which was also confirmed as canon.<ref name="conan">{{WebCite|url=http://blog.nbc.com/latenight/2007/05/breaking_hearts_and_making_far.php|text=I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing&hellip;|author=Bleyaert, Aaron|date=2007-05-02|quote=There is now officially a ''Star Wars'' character named after Conan!!|archivedate=20071222020334}}</ref>

On [[September 14]], 2010, a month after being named, Stewjon was listed as Kenobi's homeworld on his "[[Clone Cards|Clone Card]]," an online supplement to [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, marking its first appearance in an official source.<ref name="clonecardobi" /><ref name="clonecard">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/digital_clone_cards/index.html|text=StarWars.com Digital Clone Cards}}</ref> On [[March 16]], [[2011]], Stewjon was given a [[Star system/Legends|system]] named after itself in the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> Despite these references and another from a book entitled ''[[Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi]]'',<ref name="Mysteries of the Jedi">''[[Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi]]''</ref> the ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', published on [[June 20]], 2011,<ref name="2011 Books">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/booknews_2011/index.html|text=More Books News: 2011 Releases for All Ages|date=2011-02-16}}</ref> provided Coruscant as Kenobi's homeworld as in the original ''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia''.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
